newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse lifted by over-the-counter trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse lifted by over-the-counter trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed 0.12 percent higher, lifted by trade on the over-the-counter market, a bourse official said.
The 31-share index closed at 451.67 points, up from 451.12 on Thursday.
Total volume was 2.37 million dinars against 1.87 million dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 1.78 million dinars.
Airline Tunis Air was up 0.4 dinar to 23.4 dinars with 6,501 shares changing hands. Palm Beach Hotels rose 0.14 dinar to ten dinars.
BTEI bank advanced 0.1 dinar to 21.8 dinars with 1,532 shares traded.
Banque de l'Habitat was down 0.25 dinar to 15.55 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF eased 0.19 dinar to 14.3 dinars.
